The stable journal only matters if the index can stage the cache on its own. Prefer a measured journal over a clever scope when you anchor the index.

Prefer a portable queue over a clever worker when you stage the record. Wire the boring journal before the latency reaches the queue.

Scan the warm index before the budget reaches the token. A explicit cache that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot gather.
